workflow.content:
name: Scotty native type checks 20261125

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - task/type-app-checks-20261125

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: scotty-type-checks-20261125
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  checks:
    if: github.repository == 'YossiMH/bead-me-up-scotty'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 30
    env:
      CI: 'true'
      NODE_OPTIONS: '--max-old-space-size=4096'
      NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED: '1'
      POSTHOG_KEY: ''
      BUILD_SHA: '0309539'
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash
    steps:
      - name: Create isolated output and test directories
        timeout-minutes: 1
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          check_root="$RUNNER_TEMP/scotty-type-checks-$GITHUB_RUN_ID-$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT"
          test ! -e "$check_root"
          mkdir -p "$check_root/results" "$check_root/fixtures" "$check_root/temporary"
          printf 'SCOTTY_CHECK_ROOT=%s\n' "$check_root" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          printf 'SCOTTY_TEST_ROOT=%s/fixtures\n' "$check_root" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          printf 'TMPDIR=%s/temporary\n' "$check_root" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          printf '%s\n' "$GITHUB_SHA" > "$check_root/results/workflow-commit.txt"

      - name: Read the exact app candidate
        uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803
        timeout-minutes: 3
        with:
          ref: 0309539797fd7d016e2b8fd8bdc0ae9cefc20219
          fetch-depth: 2
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Select the previously used Node version
        uses: actions/setup-node@249970729cb0ef3589644e2896645e5dc5ba9c38
        timeout-minutes: 3
        with:
          node-version: '24.22.3'
          package-manager-cache: false

      - name: Run adapter checks and build production files
        timeout-minutes: 22
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import hashlib, json, os, pathlib, subprocess, sys
          output = pathlib.Path(os.environ["SCOTTY_CHECK_ROOT"]) / "results"
          source = subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True, timeout=10).strip()
          tree = subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD^{tree}"], text=True, timeout=10).strip()
          assert source == "0309539797fd7d016e2b8fd8bdc0ae9cefc20219", source
          assert tree == "84bb66cde1832ad8d30b63773efb77c952787b94", tree
          result = {"source_commit": source, "source_tree": tree, "commands": [],
                    "node": subprocess.check_output(["node", "--version"], text=True, timeout=10).strip(),
                    "npm": subprocess.check_output(["npm", "--version"], text=True, timeout=10).strip()}
          sources = ["package.json", "package-lock.json", "next.config.ts", "lib/native-process.ts",
                     "lib/native-store.ts", "lib/native-edit.ts", "docs/backend-compatibility.md",
                     "scripts/fixtures/native-contract.mjs", "scripts/test-native-editing.mjs",
                     "scripts/test-local-bead-rs.mjs", "scripts/test-native-type-roundtrip.mjs"]
          records = []
          for name in sources:
              data = pathlib.Path(name).read_bytes()
              records.append({"path": name, "sha256": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(), "bytes": len(data),
                              "git_blob": subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD:" + name],
                                                                  text=True, timeout=10).strip()})
          (output / "source-sha256.json").write_text(json.dumps(records, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
          commands = [
              ("npm-ci", ["npm", "ci", "--no-audit", "--no-fund"], 420),
              ("adapter-tests", ["node", "--test", "--test-reporter=tap", "scripts/test-backend-contract.mjs",
                                "scripts/test-native-editing.mjs", "scripts/test-native-mutations.mjs",
                                "scripts/test-native-mutation-outcomes.mjs",
                                "scripts/test-native-credential-tenures.mjs"], 180),
              ("lint", ["npm", "run", "lint"], 180),
              ("committed-diff-check", ["git", "diff", "--check", "HEAD^", "HEAD"], 30),
              ("diff-check", ["git", "diff", "--check"], 30),
              ("build", ["npm", "run", "build"], 600),
              ("type-check", ["node", "node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc", "--noEmit"], 120),
              ("tracked-source-check", ["git", "diff", "--exit-code", "HEAD"], 30),
          ]
          for name, command, seconds in commands:
              with (output / (name + ".stdout")).open("wb") as stdout, (output / (name + ".stderr")).open("wb") as stderr:
                  completed = subprocess.run(["timeout", "--signal=TERM", "--kill-after=10s", str(seconds) + "s",
                                              *command], stdout=stdout, stderr=stderr, check=False)
              result["commands"].append({"name": name, "command": command, "exit": completed.returncode,
                                         "timeout_seconds": seconds})
              (output / "result.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
              print(json.dumps(result["commands"][-1]), flush=True)
              print((output / (name + ".stdout")).read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace"), flush=True)
              print((output / (name + ".stderr")).read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace"), flush=True)
              if completed.returncode != 0:
                  sys.exit(completed.returncode)
          result["remaining_edit_directories"] = sorted(p.name for p in pathlib.Path(os.environ["TMPDIR"]).iterdir()
                                                        if p.name.startswith("scotty-edit-"))
          (output / "result.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
          assert result["remaining_edit_directories"] == [], result["remaining_edit_directories"]
          PY

      - name: Record the complete runtime ZIP and manifest
        timeout-minutes: 2
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import hashlib, json, os, pathlib, re, subprocess, zipfile
          output = pathlib.Path(os.environ["SCOTTY_CHECK_ROOT"]) / "results"
          result = json.loads((output / "result.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
          assert all(command["exit"] == 0 for command in result["commands"])
          tap = (output / "adapter-tests.stdout").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
          counts = {field: int(re.search(r"^# " + field + r" (\d+)$", tap, re.M)[1])
                    for field in ["tests", "pass", "fail", "cancelled", "skipped", "todo"]}
          assert counts["tests"] > 48 and counts["pass"] == counts["tests"], counts
          assert all(counts[field] == 0 for field in ["fail", "cancelled", "skipped", "todo"]), counts
          result["adapter_tests"] = counts
          omitted = ["cache", "diagnostics", "trace", "trace-build", "types"]
          selected = []
          for filename in sorted(pathlib.Path(".next").rglob("*")):
              relative = filename.relative_to(".next")
              if relative.parts[0] in omitted:
                  continue
              assert not filename.is_symlink(), str(filename)
              if filename.is_file():
                  selected.append(filename)
          assert selected and pathlib.Path(".next/BUILD_ID") in selected
          assert len({str(name).casefold() for name in selected}) == len(selected)
          records = []
          archive = output / "scotty-runtime.zip"
          with zipfile.ZipFile(archive, "x", compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED, compresslevel=6) as package:
              for filename in selected:
                  data = filename.read_bytes()
                  records.append({"path": filename.as_posix(), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(), "bytes": len(data)})
                  package.writestr(filename.as_posix(), data)
          manifest = {
              "source_commit": result["source_commit"], "build_sha": os.environ["BUILD_SHA"],
              "build_id": pathlib.Path(".next/BUILD_ID").read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip(),
              "file": archive.name, "sha256": hashlib.sha256(archive.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
              "bytes": archive.stat().st_size, "omitted": omitted, "node_modules_transferred": False,
              "dependency_lock_sha256": hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path("package-lock.json").read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
              "dependency_lock_git_blob": subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD:package-lock.json"],
                                                                  text=True, timeout=10).strip(),
              "node": result["node"], "npm": result["npm"], "files": records,
          }
          manifest_path = output / "scotty-runtime.json"
          manifest_path.write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
          result["runtime"] = {"manifest": manifest_path.name, "manifest_sha256": hashlib.sha256(manifest_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                               "file_count": len(records), "archive": archive.name, "archive_sha256": manifest["sha256"],
                               "archive_bytes": manifest["bytes"], "build_id": manifest["build_id"]}
          result["status"] = "passed"
          (output / "result.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
          print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
          PY

      - name: Retain actual outputs and runtime
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        timeout-minutes: 2
        with:
          name: scotty-type-checks-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/scotty-type-checks-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}/results/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14
